target: de nas las kyi dbang po lnga'i sbyor bas brjod pa dang / len pa dang / 'gro ba dang / bshang ba dang / gci ba'i bya ba skyes pa na byis pa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid de de bzhin du lha yang kA ki kI k+R-i k+R-I ku kU kl-i kl-I k+ha k+hA k+Ya k+YA k+Ra k+RA k+Wa k+WA kla klA ka kA ke kai kar kAr ko kau kal kAl kaM kaHzhes pa ste lo bcu gnyis kyi mtshams rdzogs pa'o/ / de nas lo bcu drug gi mtshams su ji ltar byis pa'i khu ba 'pho ba na bzhi pa'i gnas skabs su 'gyur zhing bzhi pa de nyid sku bzhi pa dang phung po drug pa dang khams drug pa dang dbang po drug pa dang yul drug pa dang las kyi dbang po drug pa dang las kyi dbang po'i bya ba drug par 'gyur te/

bo: 'dir dpal ldan ka lA pa'i grong gi lho ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal gyi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i shar sgo'i mthar
target: mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas las ye shes kyi le'u la zla ba bzang pos gsol ba btab pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i lan gyi gsung tshigs su bcad pa dang pos gsungs pa/ gtso bo'i sgrub thabs rgyal ba mchog dang bcas pa gang zhig khyod kyis gsungs pa dag ni cung zad shes/ / slar yang bdag ni nyan par 'tshal lo lha mi'i bla ma khams kyi dbye ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor dang / / 'dir dpal ldan ka lA pa'i grong gi lho ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal gyi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i shar sgo'i mthar/
src_sentence: iha śrīmati kalāpagrāmadakṣiṇamalayodyāne śrīkālacakramaṇḍala gṛhapūrvadvārāvasāne ratnamaṇḍape mahāmaṇiratnasiṃhāsanastho yaśonarendro mañjuśrīnirmitakāyo brahmarṣisūrya- rathādhyeṣitaḥ paramādibuddhājjñānapaṭale sucandrādhyeṣaṇaṃ tathāgataprativacanaṃ prathamavṛttenāha- kiñcijjñātaṃ hi bhartujinavarasahitaṃ sādhanaṃ yattvayoktaṃ bhūyo'haṃ śrotukāmastridaśanaraguro maṇḍalaṃ dhātubhedaiḥ buddhānāṃ ṣaṭkulāni tvalikaliṣu gatānyeva ṣaḍ yoginīnāṃ śrutvā saucandravākyaṃ gadati jinapati rdhātubhimaṇḍalādyam ||

target: de rnams sun phyung ste de nas dmangs rigs la sogs pa rnams la phyin ci log gi chos ston par 'gyur ba ni 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / thabs kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / smon lam gyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol du phyin pa ste pha rol du phyin pa bcu po 'di rnams byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ / de rnams sun phyung ste de nas dmangs rigs la sogs pa rnams la phyin ci log gi chos ston par 'gyur ba ni 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / thabs kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / smon lam gyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol du phyin pa ste pha rol du phyin pa bcu po 'di rnams byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /
src_sentence: tatastān dūṣayitvā śūdrādīnāṃ viparītadharmaṃ deśayi- 30 tadyathā - dānapāramitā śīlapāramitā kṣāntipāramitā vīryapāramitā dhyāna- pāramitā prajñāpāramitā upāyapāramitā praṇidhipāramitā balapāramitā jñānapāramitā etā daśapāramitā bodhisattvaḥ paripūraṇīyāḥ |

target: de bzhin du mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying por gyur pa gsol pa 'debs pa dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brgya drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu bstan to/ / de la de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang zhes pa la sogs pa nas lus btud nas ni spyan sngar 'dug ces pa'i mthar thug pa ni gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu drug go/ / de bzhin du mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying por gyur pa gsol ba 'debs pa dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brgya drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu bstan to/ / de la de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang zhes pa la sogs pa nas lus btud nas ni spyan sngar 'dug ces pa'i mthar thug pa ni gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu drug go/ / a ra pa tsa nA ya te na maH/ / zhes bya ba'i bar gyi tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa bstan/ / 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /
